blocks.tamil_translation: compassion. Because of it, wild animals show affection to their young. The remaining ninety-nine mercies He has kept with Himself to shower upon His servants on the Day of Qiyamah.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Another narration states that on the Day of Qiyamah, Allah will add the Rahmah He gave to the people of the world to these Rahmahs and make it complete (then, through these hundred Rahmahs, He will shower a rain of mercy upon His servants).
(Muslim)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قُدِمَ عَلَي رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ بِسَبْيٍ فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ السَّبْيِ تَبْتَغِي إِذَا وَجَدَتْ صَبِيّاً فِي السَّبْيِ أَخَذَتْهُ فَاَلْصَقَتْهُ بِبَطْنِهَا وَأَرْضَعَتْهُ، فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَتَرَوْنَ هذِهِ الْمَرْأَةَ طَارِحَةً وَلَدَهَا فِي النَّارِ؟ قُلْنَا: لَا وَاللهِ! وَهِيَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَي أَنْ لَا تَطْرَحَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَلّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هذِهِ بِوَلَدِهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في سعة رحمة الله تعالي.....رقم: رقم: ٦٩٧٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Once some captives were brought to the presence of Rasulullah ﷺ. Among them was a woman. She was searching for her child. As soon as she found the child, she scooped it up, hugged it to her belly and breastfed it. Seeing this scene, the Prophet ﷺ asked us, “Do you think this woman would throw her child into the fire?” We said, “By Allah! She would not throw it. She could not even throw it.” “Allah has affection for His servants many times more than the affection this woman has for her child.” Hazrat Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA)
